conclusion.determination: The CLIN officially defines 68 groupings in 5 independent locations (pp. 8, 10, 11, 231, 233) and provides a complete nominal list of 68 on pages 11-12. However, the catalog main body (pp. 30-212) and Appendix 4 only contain 67 groupings with variants. The missing grouping is 'Q'anjob'al' which appears in the index (p.11) and has variants in the catalog (p.189: K'anjob'al, Akateko, Qato'k, Chuj, Jakalteko) but is omitted from Appendix 4. The three extinct candidates (tepecano, ópata, tubar) appear only in genealogical trees with † markers, not in the index or catalog. The CLIN does not explicitly state whether the official 68 includes extinct groupings. Therefore, the 68 cannot be documentally reconciled with the 67 reconstructed from catalog content. Status: UNKNOWN.
